      • getAuthenticationAlgorithm

        @Deprecated
public java.lang.String getAuthenticationAlgorithm()
        Deprecated.
        this method is deprecated and may be removed in a future release
        Gets the authenticationAlgorithm. The authentication algorithm. The `md5` and `sha1` algorithms have been deprecated. The enumerated values for this property may [expand](https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/vpc#property-value-expansion) in the future. If `multiple`, the policy supports more than one authentication algorithm. Use the `authentication_algorithms` property to retrieve all supported algorithms.
        Returns:
        the authenticationAlgorithm

      • getAuthenticationAlgorithms

        public java.util.List<java.lang.String> getAuthenticationAlgorithms()
        Gets the authenticationAlgorithms. The authentication algorithms to use for IKE Negotiation. The order of the algorithms in this array indicates their priority for negotiation, with each algorithm having priority over the one after it.
        Returns:
        the authenticationAlgorithms

      • getDhGroup

        @Deprecated
public java.lang.Long getDhGroup()
        Deprecated.
        this method is deprecated and may be removed in a future release
        Gets the dhGroup. The Diffie-Hellman group Groups `2` and `5` have been deprecated. If `65535`, the policy supports more than one Diffie-Hellman group. Use the `dh_groups` property to retrieve all supported Diffie-Hellman groups.
        Returns:
        the dhGroup

      • getDhGroups

        public java.util.List<java.lang.Long> getDhGroups()
        Gets the dhGroups. The Diffie-Hellman groups to use for IKE negotiation. The order of the Diffie-Hellman groups in this array indicates their priority for negotiation, with each Diffie-Hellman group having priority over the one after it.
        Returns:
        the dhGroups

      • getEncryptionAlgorithm

        @Deprecated
public java.lang.String getEncryptionAlgorithm()
        Deprecated.
        this method is deprecated and may be removed in a future release
        Gets the encryptionAlgorithm. The encryption algorithm. If `multiple`, the policy supports more than one encryption algorithm. Use the `encryption_algorithms` property to retrieve all supported algorithms. The `triple_des` algorithm has been deprecated. The enumerated values for this property may [expand](https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/vpc#property-value-expansion) in the future.
        Returns:
        the encryptionAlgorithm
